name: Carrion Quarry
blurb: A vast pit of pale stone where something enormous was buried and partially exhumed, its ribcage still half-locked in the earth.
art_prompt: exposed limestone cliff face, massive curved bone ribs half-embedded, rust-stained fractures, pale dust coating everything, dark soil seams, weathered vertebrae, scattered pale rubble, ochre and grey
shape: a sheer vertical face filling the whole view

name: Bloat Mere
blurb: A fetid swamp where a drowned colossus rots half-submerged, its corpse a island of bone and slick corruption that pilgrims dare not approach.
art_prompt: colossal ribcage half-buried in black-green water, bone yellowed and split, moss-slick stones, rust-brown sediment clouds, fetid steam, skeletal fingers of sunken wood jutting from mire
shape: one colossal object dominating the frame

name: Ashen Sluice
blurb: A vast foundry's runoff channel, now a wasteland of cracked grey slag and rust-stained stone where things that hunger for metal have made their nests.
art_prompt: cracked grey slag field, rust-red mineral veins, black iron tailings, pale ash coating everything, distant furnace-stack silhouettes, thin smoke band across sky
shape: open ground under sky, seen close: the surface itself is the subject (cracked salt, ash dunes, black water, bone shingle), sky as a thin band.

name: Furnace Wound
blurb: A vast foundry split by a chasm of cooled slag and still-glowing veins, where the forges of some dead civilization rust in the dark.
art_prompt: massive iron foundry pit, black basalt walls, rust-red and ochre slag heaps, golden seams of cooling metal glowing in the depths, chains and copper piping corroded green, ash-pale dust hanging still
shape: looking down into a shaft or pit from its rim, the far side visible across the gap.

name: Rib Cathedral
blurb: A forest of titanic white bones rises from smoking earth, their marrow veins glowing amber where reality has split open between them.
art_prompt: white bone spires packed dense, amber marrow-light bleeding through fractures, black ash settling on curved surfaces, violet void visible between the ribs, rust-red fissures in the smoking ground below
shape: a dense thicket or forest of vertical forms

name: Godfall Ravine
blurb: A chasm split by the toppling of a dead titan, its petrified flesh forming cliffs that bleed luminous ichor into pools of impossible geometry below.
art_prompt: colossal fossilized ribcage descending into darkness, grey-white bone half-submerged in amber luminescent fluid, fractal edges where reality tears, black void beyond the furthest ribs, wisps of bioluminescent gas
shape: a hall, corridor or cavern receding away. Use this SPARINGLY.
